title: Gradient Descent
description: The quiet engine underneath iterative learning.

content.text: Gradient descent turns a local slope into a direction of travel. Repeated carefully, it can move a model toward parameters that reduce the loss we care about.
A step that is too small makes progress expensive. A step that is too large can skip across useful valleys. Learning rate schedules are therefore not decoration; they are part of the experiment.

content.title: Keep the objective visible
content.text: A lower training loss is not automatically a better explanation of the world.
